1. Start Spotify playback on this phone.
2. Open Settings → Modes and Routines → Routines → +.
3. Choose an If trigger. For a physical key, look for Routines+ → Button action if installed and supported.
4. Then → Apps → Open an app or do an app action → Media Actions → Next track (or another action).
5. Save, test unlocked, then securely locked with the display off.

Menu names and available buttons vary by firmware. Record whether unlock is requested and whether the display wakes. If the action is missing or blocked, this integration is unverified for your firmware.
Transparent, resizable media controls with adjustable icon size and spacing.
The widget background is fully transparent. Resize it in LockStar, then fine-tune the icons here.
Preview on sample wallpaper. The wallpaper is not part of the widget.
Applies to all Media controls widgets.

In Good Lock → LockStar, enable lock-screen editing and open the widget area or Add widget control, if available. Choose Media Actions → Media controls, place it, and drag its resize handles. Menu names and sizing depend on your LockStar version.\n\nThe three buttons work directly without opening this app. Grant Notification access here first. The widget has no song title or live playback indicator. Locked interaction and LockStar compatibility need testing on your phone.
